keyEvents.text: Richard Ledezma (Guadalajara) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Roberto Alvarado (Guadalajara).
Juan Guevara (León) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Diego Campillo (Guadalajara).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half begins León 0, Guadalajara 0.
Díber Cambindo (León) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Iván Rodríguez (León) is shown the red card.
Substitution, León. Jesús Lara replaces Fernando Beltrán.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Ricardo Marín replaces Richard Ledezma.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Brian Gutiérrez replaces Omar Govea.
Substitution, León. Paúl Bellón replaces Díber Cambindo.
Substitution, León. Christopher Mora replaces Sebastián Vegas.
Goal! León 0, Guadalajara 1. Ricardo Marín (Guadalajara) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Daniel Aguirre.
Substitution, León. Edgar Guerra replaces Iván Moreno.
Substitution, León. Ismael Díaz replaces Juan Guevara because of an injury.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Jordán Carrillo replaces Efraín Álvarez.
Substitution, Guadalajara. José Castillo Pérez replaces Daniel Aguirre.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Luis Gabriel Rey replaces Rubén González.
Goal! León 1, Guadalajara 1. Paúl Bellón (León) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jhohan Romaña following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Óscar García (León).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, León 1, Guadalajara 1.
